build_amount.description: The build cost captured at intake, if one was — never invented.

build_provenance.description: What the captured figure IS. Empty when nothing was captured.

build_basis.description: Where the build figure rests: for a captured figure, where in the intake it came from; for `build_fte_days`, what the effort is estimated from (the building blocks, the integrations) — the basis a reviewer checks.

notes.description: Anything the design needs that is not a catalogue component and so will not be in the join — named, for the Review Board.

build_fte_days.description: When NOTHING was captured at intake: the build effort in FTE-days, ONLY with a basis in `build_basis` a reviewer can check (e.g. per building block the design declares). The run prices it at the published delivery day rate. Omit rather than guess.
